card.name: Early words in forum replies
card.fires_on: Short function words early in a casual forum or comment reply, such as It's, they, like, to, also, right or Yes. The text is conversational and replies to another poster.

modes.label: Reply openers
modes.description: Pronoun or contraction starting a comment right after a date or poster header.

modes.label: Mid-clause linking words
modes.description: Small words inside a reply, leading into an added point or advice.
modes.example: To that I'd also<< like>> to add that the prevalence of this phrase

card.plain: It fires on small everyday words in informal online replies, where the writer is about to add a comment.
